meaning: A powerful computer that stores websites and files. It sends them to your device when you ask.
clues: It holds information for other people to use.
It is a whole computer, not just a part inside one.
It answers requests from your phone or laptop, like sending a page when you open a site.
Companies keep rows of them in big buildings called data centers.
It has six letters and starts with S. A waiter has almost the same job title.
assumes: A hard drive is the part inside a computer that stores files
A web browser is a program for visiting websites
A desktop computer is a personal computer that sits on a desk

decoys.meaning: The part inside a computer that stores files.
A program you use to visit websites, such as Chrome or Safari.
A personal computer made to sit on a desk.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Like a librarian: you ask, they fetch. Only the server never says shush.

exchange.text: Tip: when a site is down, it is often the server's trouble and not your phone. Wait a few minutes and try again.
